Facility address 7487 S State Road 121, Macclenny, FL 32063 corroborated by third-party listings (not first-party).

checks.note: GET returned HTTP 404 (both www and apex). Consistent with prior finding no-cms-hpt-txt-published.

checks.check: standard charges PDF (bounded sample, first 262,144 of 236,634+ bytes)
checks.note: Sample is a PDF whose extracted text shows a standard charges table: PROCEDURE CODE, PROCEDURE DESCRIPTION, STANDARD FEE, DISCOUNTED CASH FEE, CLAIM TYPE, TYPE 2, DEPARTMENT CODE, REVENUE CODE; rows include room and board certified/non-certified psychiatric wards, venipuncture 36415, X-ray 70100/70140, with dollar amounts (e.g. $377.31, $503.75, $10.27, $96.86). Header per search snippet: EFFECTIVE DATE 07/01/2026.

established: Recorded official domain myflfamilies.com is the operator (Florida DCF) site hosting a standard charges document for Northeast Florida State Hospital, effective 07/01/2026 per document title.

The published format is PDF, not a CMS machine-readable CSV/JSON; the sample table shows standard/discounted-cash fee columns but no payer-specific negotiated rates were observed in the sampled bytes.
No /cms-hpt.txt pointer at the operator domain root (404).
